name: 进程管家
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="8" rx="2"/><rect x="2" y="14" width="20" height="8" rx="2"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="6.01" y2="6"/><line x1="6" y1="18" x2="6.01" y2="18"/></svg>
description: 用 pm2 统一托管 AI 启动的后台任务：长期服务与调试实例一律进 pm2，宿主顶栏「后台任务」面板与插件面板同一份列表，可看状态/CPU/内存/重启/日志、单独停止或删除；裸后台启动（nohup、尾部 &、start /b）被硬闸门拦下并指路；未装 pm2 时一键安装。
descriptionEn: Supervise every AI-started background task with pm2: long-running services and debug instances go through pm2, so the host background-tasks panel and the plugin panel show one shared list with status/CPU/memory/restarts/logs plus per-app stop or delete; raw detached launches (nohup, trailing &, start /b) are blocked with guidance; one-click pm2 install when missing.

settings.label: 裸后台启动拦截
settings.hint: deny：AI 用 nohup / 尾部 & / start /b 起长期任务时直接拒绝并指路 pm2（命令里带 #bg-ok 可放行）；off：只提示不拦。

settings.label: pm2 入口路径（可选）
settings.hint: 留空自动探测（node 前缀 → npm root -g → 环境变量 PI_WEB_PM2）。填绝对路径时指向 pm2 的 bin/pm2（JS 入口，不是 .cmd 垫片）。
